overview: Journey-first decomposition of E2E v3 parity into 14 granular Ralph stories across 4 core user journeys.
goals: Keep testing granular with more than 10 stories.
Group stories into 4 core journeys for clearer planning and reporting.
Preserve direct traceability to legacy 0001..0010 slices.
nonGoals: Introduce product scope beyond F1..F10 parity.
successMetrics: All 14 stories complete with acceptance and negative-path evidence.
Each story traces to at least one legacy slice source.
Cross-surface trust, export safety, and error contracts remain deterministic.

stories.title: Shell Wayfinding Baseline
stories.description: Validate shell posture and wayfinding determinism when entering matters flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Given demo mode and at least one matter, opening /matters renders shell with Matters active.
When operator moves list -> detail -> list, navigation state remains deterministic.
Then environment badge, breadcrumb, and sticky identifiers are visible and non-empty.
Example: badge shows demo posture and breadcrumb includes Matters > Matter Name.
Negative: placeholder tabs do not route to broken or ambiguous screens.

stories.title: Matter Discovery Filtering
stories.description: Validate deterministic search and saved-view filtering in matter discovery.
acceptanceCriteria: Given seeded matters, list supports search and saved-view filters.
When filters are applied in sequence, row set updates deterministically.
Then filtered state remains explicit and reversible.
Example: saved view plus query yields a stable row subset.
Negative: no filter combination renders ambiguous blank state without guidance.

stories.title: Matter Create Upload and Readiness Guidance
stories.description: Validate create/upload setup lane and explicit readiness reasons.
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid file input, creating matter and uploading document transitions setup rows through ingest states.
When readiness is recomputed, reason is explicit as ready, blocked, or already complete.
Then next-action guidance is visible for blocked states.
Example: missing required docs yields blocked with concrete next-step copy.
Negative: create without required matter name fails visibly and creates no matter.

stories.title: Quick Start Readiness Gate
stories.description: Validate run start readiness gating in Quick Start flow.
acceptanceCriteria: Given blocked matter, Quick Start is visibly blocked with reason.
When readiness transitions to runnable, Quick Start starts a run.
Then run state and progress are visible immediately.
Example: blocked-to-ready transition enables run creation without reload hacks.
Negative: blocked start returns explicit conflict error and never silently fails.

stories.title: Run Triage Tab Scope Contract
stories.description: Validate tab filtering behavior while preserving run scope.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a run with mixed statuses, triage tabs are visible.
When each tab is selected, rows filter by status only.
Then run scope remains unchanged while tab changes.
Example: Needs Review count matches visible rows.
Negative: tab switching never cross-loads rows from another run.

stories.title: Drawer Decisions and Mutation Feedback
stories.description: Validate drawer-first decisions, clipboard behavior, and deterministic mutation error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Given needs_review row, opening row launches drawer with payload and controls.
When mark reviewed or flag issue is triggered, row and drawer states update.
Then copy action emits explicit success/failure confirmation.
Example: marking reviewed updates row chip without full-page refresh.
Negative: mutation failure renders ErrorBanner and does not pretend success.

stories.title: Valid Citation Trust Viewer Verification
stories.description: Validate valid citation viewer path with overlays and trust metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Given valid citation from report or chat, source chip opens viewer at expected document and page.
When viewer loads, highlight overlay and trust metadata render from payload.
Then reset-to-100 action restores explicit verification posture.
Example: valid citation shows polygons and no citation_failed panel.
Negative: missing metadata payload shows deterministic fallback state.

stories.title: Invalid Citation Fail Closed
stories.description: Validate fail-closed behavior for unresolved or corrupted citations.
acceptanceCriteria: Given corrupted citation, source-chip behavior respects anchor gating.
When invalid citation opens, viewer renders citation_failed reason code.
Then highlight overlay count is zero.
Example: unresolved anchor chip is disabled with explanation.
Negative: invalid citation never renders stale or approximate highlight overlays.

stories.title: Safe Run Scoped Exports
stories.description: Validate safe export behavior for completed runs only.
acceptanceCriteria: Given run selector context, only completed runs are selectable for export.
When safe run is selected, CSV and DOCX exports produce downloadable artefacts.
Then artefact metadata remains bound to selected run id.
Example: completed safe run exports both formats successfully.
Negative: export action is not enabled for incomplete runs.

stories.title: Blocked Export Recovery Deep Link
stories.description: Validate blocked export panel and recovery route back to failed rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Given run with verification failures, blocked export panel appears deterministically.
When operator clicks Review failed rows, report opens with matching run_id.
Then failed-row filter is pre-applied.
Example: blocked panel includes failed-row count and recovery CTA.
Negative: blocked run never silently produces export artefact.

stories.title: Artefact Provenance Retrieval and Download Safety
stories.description: Validate provenance-rich artefact retrieval with deterministic filters and download error behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Given mixed artefacts, list renders provenance metadata.
When kind, type, or safety filters are applied, row set updates deterministically.
Then each row shows source_run_id and actionable download control.
Example: unsafe filter shows only UNSAFE-labelled rows with explanation copy.
Negative: expired signed URL renders deterministic error and never silently fails.

stories.title: L1 Run Scoped Chat Contract
stories.description: Validate run-scoped chat selection, streaming, and source-chip clickability rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Given completed runs, chat defaults to most recent completed run.
When question is submitted, UI shows streaming then final response.
Then source chips are clickable only for anchor-ready citations.
Example: selected versus effective run mismatch disclosure appears when metadata differs.
Negative: missing indexed context disables composer with guidance instead of sending request.

stories.title: Demo Operator Pack Load Reload Loop
stories.description: Validate demo toolbar allowlist behavior, pack load/reload, and history continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Given demo mode, toolbar shows explicit DEMO MODE and allowlisted packs.
When pack loads, system creates or opens deterministic demo matter context.
Then checklist progression and elapsed timing are rendered or explicitly unavailable.
Example: load pack again creates a new demo matter without destructive reset of prior records.
Negative: non-allowlisted pack id fails validation and creates no matter.

stories.title: Cross Surface Error Retry and Support Contract
stories.description: Validate deterministic error shape, retry behavior, and support guidance across surfaces.
acceptanceCriteria: Given representative failures across at least three surfaces, each renders deterministic ErrorBanner.
When failure is retryable and handler exists, Retry CTA appears and replays idempotently.
Then support CTA includes safe context fields code, trace_id, and route only.
Example: non-retryable validation error hides Retry CTA and still exposes support path.
Negative: missing support config shows fallback guidance with copyable identifiers.
